features.description: Per-family degraded honesty + structured cross-surface agreement. Add required_data_sources and allowed_degraded_modes (keyed by a shared data-source key, e.g. capability id) to the journey contract. A checker verifies degradation is honest per family and that a typed-skip counts as honest-unavailability evidence rather than journey success, and that human and agent journeys for the same objective agree on capability-availability/provenance compared by the shared key. ALL comparison reads the STRUCTURED EvidenceRef fields CONSUMED from 2a-core (merged): data_source, availability, data_provenance — never prose (D002).
features.acceptance: The UserJourney contract accepts required_data_sources[] (each with a stable data_source key) and allowed_degraded_modes[]. Evidence records availability per source structurally on EvidenceRef (consumed from 2a-core): an agent capability_unavailable signal IS an agent EvidenceRef with data_source=<key> + availability=unavailable; an honest human label IS a human EvidenceRef with data_source=<key> + availability=unavailable. A pure checker, reading {data_source, availability, data_provenance} off the EvidenceRefs keyed by data_source, reports: (1) degraded_dishonest evaluated PER REQUIRED FAMILY: for each required data_source, EACH consumer_family the journey requires must itself carry an honest availability=unavailable EvidenceRef for that key when the source is down — one family masking (omitting its unavailable signal) while the other degrades is degraded_dishonest, NOT honest (a 'neither family' test is insufficient) (D003); additionally a degraded EvidenceRef is honest ONLY if its mode is listed in the journey's allowed_degraded_modes for that data_source, else degraded_dishonest (D004); (2) that a typed-skip EvidenceRef (availability=unavailable + data_provenance=degraded) for a data_source is treated as honest-unavailability evidence and NEVER as a satisfying consumer-surface capture (test asserts a journey 'covered' only by typed-skips is not satisfied); (3) cross_surface_disagreement when the human and agent EvidenceRefs for the SAME data_source key assert different availability or data_provenance (comparison on the structured fields, not description text). The typed-skip-vs-honest-degradation discriminator is at the journey EVIDENCE-SET level, not the tuple (D005): the same {availability=unavailable, data_provenance=degraded} EvidenceRef is honest-unavailability either way; a journey is satisfied only when its evidence set ALSO contains a real (non-seeded) journey-EXECUTION EvidenceRef — a set of only unavailable/typed-skip tuples is unsatisfied. Tests cover honest-degradation pass, degraded_dishonest, typed-skip-not-success, the discriminator (same unavailable tuple, with vs without a real execution EvidenceRef -> satisfied vs not), and a keyed UI-promises-available vs API-says-unavailable disagreement. HUMAN-FAMILY COMPATIBILITY (D007): F004 does NOT rebuild human-surface capture (non-goal) — it requires only a MINIMAL additive path where existing human EvidenceRefs can populate 2a-core's structured fields (data_source, availability, consumer_family, degraded_mode) — consumed, not redefined; a test asserts a human unavailable-label EvidenceRef carrying those fields is consumed by the checker. OBJECTIVE-LEVEL COMPARISON (D006): cross_surface_disagreement is computed at the OBJECTIVE level — EvidenceRefs are collected/grouped by a pinned objective key (the journey's objective id) and then keyed by data_source within it; the human-vs-agent comparison boundary is the (objective, data_source) pair, not loose journey scanning. Pure, no I/O. AS-MERGED 2a-core ALIGNMENT (D008): consumes the MERGED 2a-core vocabulary — EvidenceRef carries data_source/availability/data_provenance/consumer_family/degraded_mode/surface_class, with 2a-core's D065 family-consistency invariant (consumer_family == SurfaceFamily(surface_class)) guaranteeing family reads are trustworthy; per-family degraded-honesty for the HUMAN family applies only to TYPED human EvidenceRefs (the D007 minimal-compat path) — an UNTYPED human family for a data_source is not_yet_typed per 2a-core D060, NOT degraded_dishonest (the deferred human-typing is not penalized). PREREQUISITE (D009): this plan's lock/build REQUIRES 2a-core (2026-06-15-001) MERGED with its EvidenceRef vocabulary + closed enums available — SATISFIED (merged to main 1b90198); the checker imports the merged closed enums/fields and does not redefine schema. REQUIRED FAMILIES (D010): each required_data_sources[] entry declares {data_source key, required_families[] subset of {human, agent}}; per-family degraded_dishonest is evaluated over EXACTLY the declared required_families for that source (closes the 'which families are required' gap). REAL-EXECUTION via CLOSED ENUM (D011): the 'real journey-execution EvidenceRef' in the typed-skip discriminator is defined using 2a-core's closed evidence_class enum — an execution-proving class (screenshot|recording|journey_walk|terminal_transcript|tool_call_transcript|cli_transcript|contract_check) with data_provenance=real AND availability=available; NOT idempotency/rollback/structured_error, NOT seeded. Consumed from 2a-core, not redefined. DETERMINISTIC REDUCTION (D012): for multiple EvidenceRefs sharing (objective, data_source, consumer_family), the family's availability reduces to unavailable iff ANY such ref asserts availability=unavailable (honest-down dominates); provenance reduces to degraded iff any is degraded else real; a family whose refs CONFLICT (an available+real AND an unavailable for the same key) is degraded_dishonest (self-inconsistent). Cross-surface comparison runs on the per-family reduced (availability, provenance). NOT_YET_TYPED (D013): a not_yet_typed human family (2a-core D060 untyped human evidence) does NOT make the journey degraded_dishonest and does NOT block the honesty verdict — the checker ABSTAINS for that family (reports human_not_yet_typed), mirroring 2a-core's agent_satisfied_human_pending; only a TYPED human family that masks (omits its unavailable while the agent family degrades) is degraded_dishonest.
